name: Joe Neguse

summary.text: Joe Neguse is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Colorado's 2nd Congressional District, first elected in 2018.

He earned a bachelor's degree and a law degree from the University of Colorado, co-founded the voter-engagement group New Era Colorado, served on the University of Colorado Board of Regents from 2008 to 2014, and was executive director of the Colorado Department of Regulatory Agencies from 2015 to 2017.
House Democrats elected him assistant leader for the 119th Congress on November 19, 2024.

research_notes: Most Colorado-specific ballot-measure statements (graduated income tax, TABOR surplus, conservation sales tax, natural gas right, zoning preemption, mail-ballot ID, plain-language ballots, redistricting commission, mail voting, minor gender-surgery ban, child-trafficking penalties, hunting right, immigration-notify-ICE) returned no sourceable statement from Neguse as a federal officeholder and are left uncoded rather than inferred from party or general ideology. Exact calendar dates for his positions on Proposition 132 and Amendment 79 are not stated on the fetched Ballotpedia page; flagged in each record's note. congress.gov and govtrack.us, which Ballotpedia cites for several roll-call numbers, are blocked to automated fetching per protocol, so roll-call numbers for additional historical votes (e.g., Assault Weapons Ban of 2022 exact date) could not be independently confirmed beyond what Ballotpedia's own page states; the gun-law record date is flagged as the bill's enactment date rather than a confirmed floor-vote date.
